instruction: Open or import the initial CAD geometry file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\part_with_vise.step. Set the two vise jaws in C:\Users\User\Desktop\part_with_vise.step as fixture/check geometry. Machine the two top pockets using safe Pocket Milling toolpaths while maintaining at least 3 mm clearance from the fixtures on all low-level toolpath points. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill for the two top pockets. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-11.nc.
